title: Masterclass digital power and sovereignty

title: Moving from big tech to public technology with Waag's Living Lab Open Socials
content: Waag’s Living Lab Open Socials was launched in June 2026. Together with media organisations, we are exploring the road to an open social web. The aim is to facilitate the transition from big tech’s most widely used social media platforms (such as Instagram and TikTok) to more social, safe and ‘open’ social media platforms.

title: Whose land is the feed? How techno-feudalism explains Meta's censorship on queer and pro-choice
content: The platforms—Amazon, Google, Apple, Meta—are no longer ordinary firms competing in a market; they are fiefs. The way out is not a kinder lord; it is to stop being a tenant.
